test_first_skipped_reason.reason: The repair branch already contained the previous red-first URL path scanner regression and fix in current HEAD. This run addressed the remaining Codex review feedback by tightening scanner ordering and adding the exact appended-path-token regression without reverting existing protection.

green_evidence.evidence: Focused ingest tests passed for high-entropy GitHub provenance URL path segments, raw and percent-encoded slash-bearing URL path tokens, clean canonical persistence, and large PR-number paths.

evidence: test-coverage passed at 78.0% against the 75.0% minimum

acceptance_results.notes: Rule validation remains tied to experience citations and PR provenance; this repair preserves provenance safety before records can become rule evidence.
Ingest now scans GitHub provenance URL paths for high-entropy payloads before permitting the safe URL-shape exemption, including tokens appended after normal PR paths.
Offline ingest continues to accept local JSON, JSON arrays, events objects, and JSONL streams and normalize events into canonical experience records after redaction.
Canonical experience records remain idempotently upserted into monthly local-only .relia/experiences shards with private share scope and org_eligible false.

plan_drift_result.notes: Repair stayed inside the Codex review feedback for T3 ingest redaction and did not widen task scope.

changelog_result.notes: Repair did not add a new public feature beyond the existing T3 ingest behavior already documented.

versioning_result.notes: Pre-1.0 repair preserves the existing command and schema contracts.

docs_sync_result.notes: README and dev/architecture guides already describe fail-closed capture-time redaction with entropy scanning; no doc contract changed.
